Description
Welcome to The Waterford, a highly sought-after luxury tower in Yaletown, ideally located along the waterfront, seawall and David Lam Park. This high-floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom corner residence offers approximately 1,110 sq. ft. of spacious living with beautiful water, park and city views. The home features an expansive floor plan, oversized floor-to-ceiling windows, air conditioning, laminate flooring, gas fireplace, granite countertops, stainless steel gas appliances, dedicated dining area and generous living space. A west-facing solarium provides an ideal home office or flex space, while the beautifully appointed bathrooms feature soaker tubs. Residents enjoy Club Viva amenities including an approximately 80-ft indoor pool, fitness centre, sauna and steam room. Unit is UNFURNISHED.
